source.document_title: Chabot College 2025-2026 Catalog - CAL-GETC Certificate of Achievement
source.effective_terms: Fall 2025, Spring 2026 and Summer 2026 (the certificate says the list is subject to change each academic year; ASSIST is the official list)

ge_pathway.name: California General Education Transfer Curriculum
ge_pathway.transfer_scope_statement: The certificate says Cal-GETC is one option to complete lower-division general education for the University of California or the California State University.

requirements.name: English Communication
requirements.rule: Three courses, one each from area: 1A, 1B, and 1C

requirements.source_label: Area 2 - Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning
requirements.name: Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning
notes: Math courses numbered “S” or those courses with similar course content may be subject to transfer unit limits at UC.

requirements.name: Arts and Humanities
requirements.rule: Two courses, with at least one course from the Arts (3A) and one course from the Humanities (3B) (6 semester/8 quarter units)

requirements.name: Social and Behavioral Sciences
requirements.rule: Two courses, from at least two different disciplines or an interdisciplinary sequence (6 semester/8 quarter units)

requirements.name: Physical and Biological Sciences
requirements.rule: Two courses, one course from 5A and one from 5B. At least one course must include a laboratory, 5C (7 semester/ 9 quarter units)

subareas.name: Lab Requirement
subareas.note: courses listed in Area 5C that are also listed in Area 5A or 5B may be used to satisfy both areas

notes: Chabot College course list for Cal-GETC, transcribed from the catalog certificate; not IGETC and not the UC 7-course pattern.
The catalog labels Ethnic Studies "Area 7"; Cal-GETC numbers it Area 6, which is used here.
A course listed in 5C and in 5A or 5B may satisfy both (catalog: "courses listed in Area 5C that are also listed in Area 5A or 5B may be used to satisfy both areas").
cal_getc_areas lists every area the certificate shows a course under.
